title: Event or conference page
when: The user wants a page for a conference, meetup, workshop, festival or launch event.
inputs: event name, date, time zone, place
prompt:
Goal: A page that makes the when, where and why obvious and gets people registered.
Steps:
1. Hero with name, date with weekday and time zone, place (or online), and a Register button.
2. Agenda as a list of time slots with title and speaker; use the time element with datetime attributes.
3. Speakers grid with photo, name, role and talk title.
4. Venue block: address, how to get there, accessibility info.
5. Registration: a form with labels or a link to the real registration; state price and deadline.
6. Add Event JSON-LD with startDate, location and offers.
Quality bar:
- Times always show the time zone.
- The agenda reads in order on a phone.
- Deadlines and prices are explicit.
Pitfalls:
- Dates without a year or weekday.
- Countdown timers that drift or break the layout.
- Agenda tables that overflow at 375 px.
Verify:
- [ ] time elements have datetime values.
- [ ] Register action appears in the hero and after the agenda.
- [ ] JSON-LD parses.
- [ ] No horizontal scroll.
Output: index.html with hero, agenda, speakers, venue and registration; style.css.

examples.input: page for a JS meetup on March 12
examples.output: hero with date and time zone, 4 talks with times, venue, register form with name and email
